state.incidentInput: Customers are seeing errors at checkout and the site feels slow. Started maybe 15–20 min ago.
state.summary: CFG-502 (inventory DB_POOL_MAX 20->80 at 13:52) lifted the potential connection budget on orders-db to 610 vs max 400. inventory holds ~318 connections (LOG-076, LOG-121), starving orders-service ("too many clients"), which causes checkout errors. High confidence, not human-confirmed.
state.impact: Checkout 5xx rose to 7.9% and p99 latency to 5s (MET-checkout.error_rate_pct, MET-checkout.p99_latency_ms). Orders error rate reached 10.3%. orders-db is at 397/400 connections (LOG-076).

timeline.note: DB connections and checkout errors begin

keySignals.why: Errors persisted after the payments rollback

noise.why: Reporting rollup CPU is a brief side effect and not the cause. It adds a few connections at most.

hypotheses.statement: inventory-service pool increase (CFG-502, DB_POOL_MAX 20->80) exhausted orders-db connections, starving orders-service and breaking checkout
hypotheses.reasoning: Marcus confirmed making the change at 13:52 (USER-001). That confirms the change was made, and the timing and connection counts fit. Inventory holds about 320 of 397 connections. The payments rollback did not clear the errors (ALR-014), and the payments latency rise comes from checkout retries. Recovery after the revert has not been reported yet, so confidence stays below 0.95.
Errors persisted after the rollback, and payments error rate and processor latency were unchanged.

openQuestions: Why did Marcus raise the pool size, and was it meant to be permanent? Ask the inventory-service owner.
Were any orders or payments left inconsistent by the failed checkouts? Ask the checkout and payments owners.
Do errors and connection counts return to baseline after the revert? Needs a responder report.

nextActions.action: Revert inventory-service DB_POOL_MAX to 20 and roll the pods, then watch orders-db connections
Re-enable payments_retry_on_timeout only after recovery is verified, and decide whether to redeploy payments v2.14.0
Add PgBouncer and a guardrail on pool-size changes (budget check against max_connections)
